note: No third-party document bytes. Every .pdf is produced by the pinned tools image from our own deterministic inputs; the .pdf bytes are gitignored and regenerable from this script.
reproducibility: qpdf outputs are byte-reproducible across runs (every qpdf invocation passes --deterministic-id, so /ID is a content hash). Ghostscript pdfwrite output is NOT byte-reproducible: it embeds a per-run /ID and timestamp, so its SHA-256 changes run to run, while byte length, object structure, and every FlateDecode compressed_bytes stay stable. hand-* and pdf-make-samples files are byte-identical across runs.

files.name: hand-base1.pdf
files.command: hand-written classic-xref PDF; object 6 /FlateDecode is a hand-built stored-block zlib stream

files.name: hand-base2.pdf
files.command: hand-written classic-xref PDF; objects 5 and 6 share one plaintext as two hand-built stored-block Flate streams

files.name: gs-default.pdf
files.command: gs -q -dNOPAUSE -dBATCH -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dCompressPages=true -dUseFlateCompression=true -dPDFSETTINGS=/default -sOutputFile=evidence/corpus/phase7/gs-default.pdf evidence/corpus/phase7/hand-base1.pdf

files.name: qpdf-compress.pdf
files.command: qpdf --deterministic-id --compress-streams=y --object-streams=generate --stream-data=compress evidence/corpus/phase7/hand-base1.pdf evidence/corpus/phase7/qpdf-compress.pdf

files.name: qpdf-linearize.pdf
files.command: qpdf --deterministic-id --linearize evidence/corpus/phase7/hand-base1.pdf evidence/corpus/phase7/qpdf-linearize.pdf

files.name: qpdf-preserve-objectstreams.pdf
files.command: qpdf --deterministic-id --object-streams=preserve evidence/corpus/phase7/hand-base2.pdf evidence/corpus/phase7/qpdf-preserve-objectstreams.pdf

files.name: qpdf-nocompress.pdf
files.command: qpdf --deterministic-id --compress-streams=n --stream-data=uncompress evidence/corpus/phase7/hand-base1.pdf evidence/corpus/phase7/qpdf-nocompress.pdf
